economicBaseline.comparisonLimitation: Local fixture comparison is synthetic, not an economic or quality benchmark.

usageSemantics.source: agents.log terminal assistant message_end only; unmodified rawUsage retained
usageSemantics.deduplication: one terminal message per run/eventOffset; responseId retained; no streaming/turn/run aggregate double counting
usageSemantics.input: Harness normalized uncached input; cacheRead separately reported. Equality input+cacheRead+cacheWrite+output=totalTokens checked per observed terminal response. Not a universal provider convention.
usageSemantics.reasoning: Already included in output; retained separately, never added again.
usageSemantics.cost: Raw usage.cost and reportedAggregateUsage.cost are local harness price estimates, not invoice or provider billing reconciliation. Extension-loaded rates differ.
usageSemantics.missing: null means unobserved/unknown, never free. Initial failed launches have observed zero terminal messages; remote charges remain unknown.
usageSemantics.tokensMethod: No local text tokenizer estimate. Prompt inventory measures UTF16 code units and UTF8 bytes only.
usageSemantics.coverage: Full retained event log pagination for each child. Parent model messages and provider-side unseen retries/cancellation charges not captured.
usageSemantics.timestamps: Original terminal message epoch milliseconds; per-request end/latency not independently exposed. Run start/finish epoch preserved.
